First let me apologize this is going to be a long post.

Having said that, I have been thinking about this for years. Depending on what transpires to virtually eradicate life on Earth, humanity might have to survive underground (in a bunker) for up to 10,000 years or longer. There are several key items that will be needed to ensure the survivability of any occupants of a Doomsday Bunker.

Requirements:

  • Ample clean water supply. Not only do you need water for food, livestock, people, laundry, sanitation, etc. you will need enough water to begin the replanting of crops outside the bunker when it is safe to leave it...As the water supply on the surface may be gone or contaminated for a long long time. I calculate that every person in the bunker will need 3 gallons of clean water per day. That accounts for water for plants/crops/livestock as well. So if you bunker has 1,000 humans, that is 3,000 gallons per day X 365 days per year equals 1.1 million gallons per year. To sustain them for 10,000 years would mean you would need 11 Billion Gallons of water. Then you would need roughly that much more to reforest/repopulate plant/animal life on the surface Meaning for 1,000 humans to survive you would need 20+ Billion gallons of fresh water that couldn't be contaminated.
  • There is no way to store enough food to last 1,000 people, plus livestock for 10,000+ years. Which means you would need advanced hydroponics around several acres to grow enough food for humans and a good 10-20 acres to grow grain/hay/feed for the livestock you have in the bunker.
  • Clean, breathable, recycled air! The humans and livestock will give off large quantities of Methane and Carbon Dioxide. Therefore no matter how vast the bunker is the air would be un-breathable within hours without a.) Someway to filter out the CO2 and b.) Someway to filter out the Methane and other pollutants that infiltrate the air supply. Enough greenery, plants, trees, crops, etc. would take care of the CO2 and could easily be complimented by Air Scrubbers like the International Space Station. I am not sure if that would solve the Methane problem as well....more investigation needed on that.
  • Equipment, raw materials and manufacturing capabilities. Things are going to break, wear out, etc. so you need to have enough supplies, materials and equipment stored to be able to continuously manufacture anything you need to keep the facility operating near 100%. You will also need heavy equipment to build, farm, etc. once you are able to leave the bunker.
  • Seeds in bulk stored in a dry environment to use to replant the planet once it is safe to leave the bunker.
  • Power, power and more power. There is no way to store enough power to last 10,000 years. Furthermore surface power sources are unreliable as most (if not all) Doomsday events would render them inoperable. Therefore, you would need a deep underground Nuclear or Fission reactor, or possible some kind of Hydro-Thermal reactor driven by the Earth's magma (volcanic) core. In any event it would need to be deep below sea level, completely autonomous and capable of operating at or near 100% for a period of 20,000 years.

Construction:

A facility large enough to accommodate 1,000 people, livestock and everything listed above in Requirements would have to absolutely massive. It would need to have multiple levels spanning thousands of feet.

  • You would need a machine capable of boring tunnels using either lasers or sound waves. The machine would need to be able to seal (stabilize) the walls, ceiling and floor of the tunnels as it drills them. I am thinking about some kind of spray on solution (possibly a rubber, plastic and carbon fiber compound) that dries almost instantly and is strong enough to withstand virtually anything.
  • I would start in the side of mountain around 5,000' altitude, drilling a tunnel 25' diameter straight to the center of the mountain. Once at the center of the mountain back out the tunnel a ways and turn, drilling a circular ring 1 mile diameter around the inside of the mountain. This first (top most ring) would serve as the Equipment storage (heavy equipment). Then from the enter of that ring (at the end of the entry tunnel) drill straight down 10,000' (5,000' below sea level). At the bottom drill a large enough area to house the power plant/reactor that will power your bunker. Once that is done run your drill back up to the top ring. Take the entry tunnel to just outside the Top Ring and start drilling at a 45' angle down to a depth of 100' below the top ring. Once you are 100' below top ring drill a second ring (level 2) with a 1 mile diameter. This ring will be directly below the top ring and it will serve as dry storage for seeds. Then drill several dozen other identical rings, dropping 100' below each other as you go down. Ring 3 (from top) would be your manufacturing facilities. Ring 4 (from top) would be your medical and scientific facilities. Ring 5 (from top) would be feed/grain/hay growing area. Ring 6 (from top) would be dry storage for feed/grain/hay. Ring 7 (from top) would be livestock pins. Ring 8 (from top) would be Solid Waste Processing from Rings 5 & 7. This is where the animal waste and unused feed/grain/hay are turned into mulch and fertilizer. Ring 9 & 10 (from top) would be Hydroponics rings where all your food is grown. Ring 11 (from top) would be where all controls for the entire facility are located. This is the Bridge or Command Center of the facility. It will also be weapons storage. Ring 12 through 16 (from top) will be the housing for the facilities human inhabitants. Ring 17-50 (from top) would be sealed Fresh Water storage tanks, that would hold 20+ billion gallons of water.
  • The center shaft of the facility would be the main Ventilation, elevator, wiring, etc. shaft for the entire bunker.
  • The center shaft would have sealed doors starting at just above the reactor level and running every hundred foot up the shaft to the bottom ring.
  • Once facility is built, stocked and inhabited a series of doors would be installed in the entry shaft. Starting at the side of the mountain and running every couple hundred feet up to the Level 1 ring. At the first sign of any Doomsday event occurring the tunnel will be sealed automatically.

Government:

Being that the facility would be sealed for up to 10,000+ years and resources are limited a government, military, police and court system would need to be implemented. The facility would need it's own constitution and laws that are strictly enforced.

  • A democratically elected Council will be chosen to oversee the facility and maintain the laws set forth below:
    • No person(s) can engage in any research, hacking, fraud or subterfuge that threatens the stability and longevity of the facility.
    • No person(s) can give birth to a child without express permission of the Council and prior genetic compatibility testing.
    • All person(s) must perform the job and duties given to them by the council until a replacement is appointed or they are assigned a new job.
    • All disagreements, conflicts, arguments and misunderstandings will be resolved by the Council and all person(s) involved will abide by the Council's decision.
  • All crimes will be judged on their severity by the Council and punishment will be doled out by the Council based on that severity. From mandatory hard labor up to death.
  • Primary and Secondary education will be provided to all occupants of the city who wish to further their education. Doing so does not guarantee a better/different job however.
  • There will be no currency, no one will be paid, everything will be rationed out equally regardless of your job or political affiliations.
  • All medical care, clothing, furnishings, transportation (within the facility), food, water, etc. will be rationed out equally and be completely free of charges or conditions; with the exception of when availability is an issue. When quantities are scarce items will be rationed out on a first-request/first-filled basis.

Occupants:

The initial occupants should be hand picked and include an assortment of:

  • Doctors
  • Scientists (medical, chemical, biological, etc)
  • Engineers (mechanical, electrical, etc)
  • Teachers
  • Manual Laborer's
  • Farmers
  • Botanists
  • Computer Engineers/Programmers - suggested by: /u/Mixplate

** Feel free to add anything I missed in the comments below and I will update this accordingly! **
